notes: Card pool 1–5 is the biome tag: cabinets credit the item's pool, not the delve you found it in. Returning with 5 unique items for that cabinet unlocks the next dungeon. Each biome mix totals 10 (Weak/Tough/Deadly): b1 6/3/1, b2 5/3/2, b3 5/3/2, b4 4/4/2, b5 4/3/3 (SP-17). Deadly counts across the five biomes sum to 10 so each Deadly is unique for the save. The pre-delve telegraph lists that biome's Deadly count. Later monster-entry loot still follows that monster's rank; only the opening six offers use starter_item_mix (unchanged). The 3-unique start gate counts toward the Verdant Hollow cabinet of 5.
